tools.name: preflight_capability
tools.description: Free input/price preflight before a paid endpoint invocation. No target fetch, demand or payment.

tools.name: next_best_capability
tools.description: Optional deterministic next step after using a capability. Respects budget and current availability; never purchases. Copy its attribution header when invoking the recommended endpoint.

tools.name: find_capability
tools.description: Find and quote a registered capability using its capability_id or an exact supported intent. Read-only; no demand or payment created.

tools.name: request_capability
tools.description: Find a supported outcome or capture an unmet capability request with budget, frequency, freshness and safe return path. Returns the existing durable request ID/status URL. Economic intent only; no payment or spend.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Read the opaque Broker status URL. Does not reveal original inputs, callbacks or requester identity.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: List public capability descriptions, schemas, prices and endpoints. Frozen capabilities are marked explicitly.
